economic_mechanism: The near BTCDVOL future is mechanically pulled toward the contemporaneous DVOL index as its expiry approaches. An equal-and-opposite position in the next monthly BTCDVOL future can hedge a substantial common DVOL-index component, allowing the near contract's basis-convergence component to be tested more directly.

pair_rule.population: Exact adjacent-expiry BTCDVOL pairs with listed-life overlap from the source gate population.
pair_rule.daily_anchor: For each leg, first ordinary public trade at or after 08:00 UTC on each common active UTC day within the exact overlap interval.
pair_rule.common_day: UTC date on which both near and far legs have an eligible daily anchor.
pair_rule.adjacent_observation: Within a pair, compare each common-day anchor to the next common-day anchor.

signal.near_basis: near_trade_price - near_trade_index_price at the current common-day anchor
signal.direction: near_basis > 0 => SHORT near / LONG far; near_basis < 0 => LONG near / SHORT far; near_basis == 0 => no directional observation.

primary_score.interpretation: Positive means the equal-unit calendar spread moved in the direction predicted by the near basis sign after hedging common DVOL movement.
primary_score.primary_estimand: Equal-weight mean of per-adjacent-pair mean scores.

no_rescue_rule: After the canonical outcome is opened, do not alter pair construction, equal-unit hedge ratio, 08:00 daily anchor, basis threshold, direction, score formula, sample gates, statistical gates, years or source population under this Discovery ID.
post_pass_rule: PASS authorizes only a separately frozen calendar-spread execution/cost MVE with legitimate post-signal fills on both legs. It does not authorize live trading or promotion by itself.
